Supreme Court rejects Tamil Nadu's plea against Navodaya schools

The Supreme Court has rejected Tamil Nadu's plea challenging the establishment of Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs) in the state. The court stated that Hindi cannot be kept out of the curriculum, implying its inclusion in the schools. Tamil Nadu has historically opposed the Navodaya schools, citing concerns over the imposition of Hindi. The state government has maintained its stance against the central government's education policy for decades.
